ARB_OF.doc:
The arbitrary of one type of a structure: what the functors of the
library make of a structure of the Basis Library, and what the structures
`Int8Arb`, `Word8Arb`, `CharArraySliceArb` and the rest are.

The instance of the type of a structure of the Basis Library is the `arb`
of the structure of the same name with Arb after it: `Int8Arb.arb` for
`Int8.int` (docs/plans/quickcheck.md, D4 and M6).

members.name: t
members.doc: The type.

members.name: arb
members.doc: The arbitrary of `t`.

BASIS_DATA_ARB.doc: The arbitraries of the small datatypes and readers of the Basis Library.

members.name: bufferMode
members.doc: The arbitrary of buffer modes, `IO.NO_BUF` the simplest.

members.name: radix
members.doc: The arbitrary of radixes, `StringCvt.BIN` the simplest.

members.name: traversal
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the orders in which `Array2` traverses an array,
`Array2.RowMajor` the simplest.

members.name: canonicalAbsolutePath
members.doc:
The arbitrary of canonical absolute paths: `/` and names of letters and digits between slashes, as many as a list's length.

A domain for the laws of `OS.Path` about such paths (D7).

members.name: path
members.doc:
The arbitrary of paths built from arcs: empty, `.`, `..`, names, names with an extension and any string, between slashes.

A domain for the laws of `OS.Path` (D7). A string drawn a character at
a time seldom has two separators together, which is where a path has an
empty arc, or an arc `..`. A path is absolute or relative, and the
simplest is the empty one.

members.name: reader
members.doc:
The arbitrary of readers of characters over a drawn string, whose stream is a position in it.

The string is drawn as `Arb.string` draws one. From `i`, the reader gives
the character at `i` and the position `i + 1`, and `NONE` at the end or
outside the string.

DATE_ARB.doc:
The arbitraries of `Date.date`, of its months, weekdays and record of
fields, by the generator principle P12 (docs/plans/quickcheck.md).

A date is made by `Date.date` from fields in range: a year from 1900 to
2200 (the years the specification asks for), any month, a day from 1 to
31, an hour, a minute and a second in range, and the local zone or an
offset within a day. The record of fields is drawn around those ranges,
widened on each side by their own width, so that fields out of range and
on its edges are drawn as often as fields in it; its year is any `int`.

members.name: t
members.doc: The type of dates.

members.name: arb
members.doc:
The arbitrary of dates. Two dates are equal when `Date.compare` says
so and their offsets are the same.

members.name: month
members.doc: The arbitrary of months, `Date.Jan` the simplest.

members.name: weekday
members.doc: The arbitrary of weekdays, `Date.Mon` the simplest.

members.name: fields
members.spec:
val fields : {year : int, month : Date.month, day : int, hour : int, minute : int, second : int,
              offset : Time.time option} Arb.arb
members.doc: The arbitrary of the records of fields that `Date.date` takes.

members.name: fieldsInRange
members.spec:
val fieldsInRange : int * int -> {year : int, month : Date.month, day : int, hour : int, minute : int,
                                  second : int, offset : Time.time option} Arb.arb
members.doc:
`fieldsInRange (lo, hi)` is the arbitrary of the records of fields all in range, with a year from `lo` to `hi`: a domain a law can name (D7).

The day is one of its month, the hour, the minute and the second are
within the day, and the offset is less than a day either way, or
`NONE`.

IEEE_REAL_ARB.doc: The arbitraries of `IEEEReal`'s types, by the generator principle P12.

members.name: roundingMode
members.doc: The arbitrary of rounding modes, `IEEEReal.TO_NEAREST` the simplest.

members.name: floatClass
members.doc: The arbitrary of classes of reals, `IEEEReal.NAN` the simplest.

members.name: decimalApprox
members.doc:
The arbitrary of decimal approximations.

The class is any, the sign either, the digits a list of integers from
\~10 to 19 (the digits and as many on either side), and the exponent any
`int`.

INET6_SOCK_ARB.doc:
The arbitraries of Rune's IPv6 sockets and addresses (docs/plans/quickcheck.md,
M6), apart from `SYSTEM_ARB` because `INet6Sock` is Rune's own.

members.name: inAddr
members.doc:
The arbitrary of IPv6 addresses: eight groups of 16 bits, each drawn as
`Gen.wordBits 16` draws one.

members.name: streamSock
members.doc:
`streamSock ()` is the arbitrary of new TCP sockets over IPv6, closed
when the case is over.

SML90_ARB.doc:
The arbitrary of the input streams of the optional structure `SML90`,
apart from `SYSTEM_ARB` because not every compiler has that structure.

members.name: instream
members.doc:
The arbitrary of SML '90 input streams: a file in a scratch directory
with a drawn string in it, removed when the case is over.

SYSTEM_ARB.doc:
The arbitraries of the values of the operating system that the Basis
Library's laws are written over (docs/plans/quickcheck.md, M6).

These are made, not drawn: a stream over drawn bytes or a file in a
scratch directory, a pipe, a socket, the process's own ids. What a case
makes is undone when the case is over (`Gen.resource`). A value with no
Standard ML that makes it again is shown as a comment that says what it
is.

members.name: binInstream
members.doc:
The arbitrary of binary input streams over drawn bytes, shown as the
bytes they have left.

members.name: binStreamInstream
members.doc: The arbitrary of functional binary input streams over drawn bytes.

members.name: binWriter
members.doc:
The arbitrary of binary writers that keep what they are given and
accept every write.

members.name: binOutstream
members.doc:
The arbitrary of functional binary output streams over a writer of
`binWriter`, with any buffer mode.

members.name: textInstream
members.doc:
The arbitrary of text input streams over a drawn string, shown as the
characters they have left.

members.name: textStreamInstream
members.doc: The arbitrary of functional text input streams over a drawn string.

members.name: textWriter
members.doc:
The arbitrary of text writers that keep what they are given and accept
every write.

members.name: textOutstream
members.doc:
The arbitrary of functional text output streams over a writer of
`textWriter`, with any buffer mode.

members.name: textPos
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the positions of text readers: that of a reader over a
drawn string after a drawn number of its characters.

members.name: iodesc
members.doc:
The arbitrary of I/O descriptors: the read end of a pipe, closed when
the case is over.

members.name: pollDesc
members.doc: The arbitrary of poll descriptors of `iodesc`'s pipes.

members.name: fileId
members.doc:
The arbitrary of file ids: that of a file in a scratch directory,
removed when the case is over.

members.name: syserror
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the system's errors: each that `Posix.Error` names,
`acces` the simplest.

members.name: fileDesc
members.doc:
The arbitrary of Posix file descriptors: the read end of a pipe, closed
when the case is over.

members.name: pid
members.doc: The arbitrary of process ids: the process's own and its parent's.

members.name: signal
members.doc: The arbitrary of signals: each that `Posix.Signal` names.

members.name: uid
members.doc: The arbitrary of user ids: the process's own and 0.

members.name: gid
members.doc: The arbitrary of group ids: the process's own and 0.

members.name: speed
members.doc: The arbitrary of line speeds: each that `Posix.TTY` names.

members.name: termios
members.doc:
The arbitrary of terminal settings: flags from drawn words, control
characters drawn for every index, and speeds of `speed`.

members.name: termiosFields
members.spec:
val termiosFields : {iflag : Posix.TTY.I.flags, oflag : Posix.TTY.O.flags, cflag : Posix.TTY.C.flags,
                     lflag : Posix.TTY.L.flags, cc : Posix.TTY.V.cc, ispeed : Posix.TTY.speed,
                     ospeed : Posix.TTY.speed} Arb.arb
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the records of the fields of terminal settings, as
`Posix.TTY.fieldsOf` gives them, drawn as `termios` draws settings.

members.name: ttyIflags
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the input flags of terminal settings, from a drawn
word; two are equal when their words are.

members.name: ttyOflags
members.doc: The arbitrary of the output flags of terminal settings.

members.name: ttyCflags
members.doc: The arbitrary of the control flags of terminal settings.

members.name: ttyLflags
members.doc: The arbitrary of the local flags of terminal settings.

members.name: ttyCc
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the control characters of terminal settings, one drawn
for every index; two are equal when they have the same characters.

members.name: whence
members.doc:
The arbitrary of the origins of a seek, `Posix.IO.SEEK_SET` the
simplest.

members.name: lockType
members.doc: The arbitrary of kinds of lock, `Posix.IO.F_RDLCK` the simplest.

members.name: addrFamily
members.doc: The arbitrary of address families: each of `Socket.AF.list ()`.

members.name: sockType
members.doc: The arbitrary of socket types: each of `Socket.SOCK.list ()`.

members.name: inetStreamSock
members.doc:
`inetStreamSock ()` is the arbitrary of new TCP sockets over IPv4, closed
when the case is over.

members.name: inAddr
members.doc: The arbitrary of IPv4 addresses: four drawn bytes.

members.name: hostEntry
members.doc: The arbitrary of host entries: that of `localhost`.
